newsitem.title: UK: British Gas gains amid large options trades.
newsitem.headline: British Gas gains amid large options trades.

text.p: Shares in British Gas Plc rose on Wednesday amid two large options trades and following a report in the London Evening Standard that raised the possibility of a bid from Royal Dutch/Shell Group, traders said.
British Gas was up 2-1/2p at 187-1/2 by 1203 GMT in volume of 6.7 million shares.
The Standard said there was speculation in the oil sector that Shell was looking at a large acquisition by year-end involving all or parts of British Gas.
No-one at Shell was immediately available for comment. A spokeswoman for British Gas said the company had a policy of not commenting on market speculation.
Most of the volume in British Gas options was in the December 200 calls, where 2,050 lots traded between 4p and 4-1/2p, and in the December 180 puts, where a 1,000-lot was recorded at 2p.
